agencies/agencies_member_read.using:

   FROM kauro.memberships m

domain_events/domain_events_commerce_req.check:
(((aggregate_kind <> ALL (ARRAY['quote'::text, 'payment_order'::text, 'payment_attempt'::text, 'capture'::text, 'commercial_authorization'::text, 'refund'::text, 'tax_document'::text, 'reconciliation_case'::text])) AND (split_part(event_type, '.'::text, 1) <> ALL (ARRAY['quote'::text, 'payment_order'::text, 'payment_attempt'::text, 'capture'::text, 'commercial_authorization'::text, 'refund'::text, 'tax_document'::text, 'reconciliation_case'::text]))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM kauro.commerce_event_bindings b
  WHERE ((b.event_type = domain_events.event_type) AND (b.aggregate_kind = domain_events.aggregate_kind) AND (((b.request_handler = 'TENANT'::text) AND (domain_events.agency_id = kauro.current_agency_id())) OR ((b.request_handler = 'OPERATOR'::text) AND kauro.in_finance_scope(domain_events.agency_id)))))))

   FROM (kauro.domain_events e

((agency_id = kauro.current_agency_id()) AND (class = 'UNPAID'::text) AND (revision_id IS NOT NULL) AND (soft_deadline IS NULL) AND (effective_deadline = hard_deadline) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM kauro.retention_anchors a
  WHERE ((a.agency_id = retention_records.agency_id) AND (a.anchor_id = retention_records.anchor_id) AND (a.anchor_kind = 'REVISION_SEALED'::text) AND (a.project_id = retention_records.project_id) AND (retention_records.hard_deadline = (a.occurred_at + '336:00:00'::interval))))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM kauro.retention_anchors s
  WHERE ((s.agency_id = retention_records.agency_id) AND (s.revision_id = retention_records.revision_id) AND (s.anchor_kind = 'REVISION_SEALED'::text) AND (s.occurred_at = kauro.server_now())))))
